title: Reports honesty, expense register and statements - info sheet entries

entries.title: Profit shows 'not captured' when a part of it is missing
entries.what_it_does: On the Profit and loss reports (management view), a row whose expenses, salary, fixed cost or cost of goods were never captured shows 'not captured' in the profit column instead of a number.
entries.why_it_matters: A profit that quietly leaves a missing cost out looks better than the truth.
entries.default: OFF. The profit number is exactly what it is today.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Rows with a missing part show 'not captured' in the profit and profit % columns. The extra column profit_complete always says whether the row is complete. Nothing stored changes.

entries.title: Forms are required from this date (rollout start)
entries.what_it_does: The compliance report counts a form as missing only for days from this date.
entries.why_it_matters: Without a start date every calendar day since the beginning counts as a missing form, which overstates the gap.
entries.default: Blank. The report counts every calendar day as before and says so.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Only days from the date count; holidays and the weekly closed days are left out.

entries.title: Weekly closed days for the compliance report
entries.what_it_does: Weekly days on which a place is closed (for example fri or fri,sat).
entries.why_it_matters: A closed day is not a missing form.
entries.default: Blank. No weekly closed day (the holidays list is always used once a start date is set).
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Those weekdays are left out of the missing-form count. Acts only when the start date above is set.

entries.title: Best customer: at least this many orders
entries.what_it_does: The number of orders that makes a customer a best customer (Champion) in the customer segment report.
entries.why_it_matters: The number was written into the report; it is a business decision.
entries.default: Blank. The report uses the number it always used (3) and says it was not set by the owner.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: The segment changes for customers near the line.

entries.title: Best customer: last purchase within this many days
entries.what_it_does: How recent the last purchase must be for a best customer.
entries.why_it_matters: Same reason: an owner decision, not a code constant.
entries.default: Blank. The built-in 30 days is used and the report says so.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: The segment changes for customers near the line.

entries.title: At-risk customer: no purchase for more than this many days
entries.what_it_does: How long without a purchase makes a customer at risk.
entries.default: Blank. The built-in 60 days is used and the report says so.

entries.title: Lapsed customers: look back this many days
entries.what_it_does: A customer who bought within this many days before the period but not in it is lapsed.
entries.why_it_matters: Customers silent for longer than the number are not listed at all.
entries.default: Blank. The built-in 180 days is used and the report says so.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: The lapsed list gets longer or shorter.

entries.title: Cash short/over report follows the shortage case
entries.what_it_does: The cash short and over report leaves out sheets whose shortage case was rejected or voided, and shows how many cases are open, approved, rejected and void.
entries.why_it_matters: The owner's decision on a shortage case should be visible in the report.
entries.default: OFF. The report counts the flag of every daily sheet (14-1) as today.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Rejected and voided cases no longer add to the figures.

entries.title: Cash-flow statement: journals up to this date are opening balances
entries.what_it_does: Journals dated on or before this date are shown as opening balances, not as cash inflows.
entries.why_it_matters: If the opening balances were typed as an ordinary manual journal, they would otherwise look like a big cash inflow.
entries.default: Blank. Only journals of the kind 'opening balances' are left out.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Those journals move to the 'opening balances in the period' line. The closing cash does not change.

entries.title: Basis lines under the hub reports
entries.what_it_does: Under a hub report the screen shows short notices: the profit reports say they are the management view (with a link to Profit check) and what is missing; the sales reports show a returns line; the expense reports say which of the three expense totals they are; the staff, compliance, customer segment, lapsed and cash short reports say where their numbers come from.
entries.why_it_matters: The same word 'profit', 'expenses' or 'sales' meant different things in different reports.
entries.default: Shown automatically when the database has phase 440; nothing shown otherwise.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Nothing changes in a figure. The notices are also at the end of every CSV of that report. Totals that have no value at all show 'Not captured' instead of 0.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Attendance summary reads both sources
entries.what_it_does: The staff attendance summary shows the attendance marked in the app and the paper register 02-1 in separate rows, with a column saying which is which.
entries.why_it_matters: The report used to show only the paper register and was empty while the app held the attendance.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Nothing is added together by name; the two sources stay apart.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Expense register
entries.what_it_does: One list of every expense line (vouchers 10-2 in every status, quick expenses, bank charges, wallet fees, and the marketing register 18-1 marked 'not in the books'), with the expense report, P&L, day book and journal totals side by side, a reconciliation that says why they differ, a basis selector and a CSV.
entries.why_it_matters: The same period gave three different expense totals and no screen listed the vouchers behind them.
entries.default: Open to the owner and to people with the expense report right or accounts rights. Nothing to switch on.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Read only. Nothing is posted. The existing settings (expense_count_on, report_expense_parity_on, d_wallet_fee_treatment) decide which total counts what.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone with the expense report right; the CSV also needs the export right.

entries.title: P&L by month and outlet (from the journal)
entries.what_it_does: Income, cost of goods, other expenses, gross and net profit from the books, with a column for each month and a row for each outlet; tap a cell for the accounts and entries behind it.
entries.why_it_matters: The books showed one period and one place at a time, and the management profit report is a different calculation.
entries.default: Open to the owner, accounts view or manage, and the profit report right. Needs the accounting start date, otherwise it says 'accounting module not switched on - no data captured'.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Read only. Year-end closing journals are left out. Lines with no outlet have their own row.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone with the profit report right or accounts rights; the CSV also needs the export right.

entries.title: Cash-flow statement
entries.what_it_does: Cash movements from the journal grouped as operating, investing and financing by the class of the other account of each entry; opening balances and moves between your own cash accounts are not flows. Closing cash equals the Cash flow tab of Accounts.
entries.why_it_matters: The old tab only listed movements by source, so an opening balance looked like a big inflow and a bank deposit like an inflow and an outflow.
entries.default: Needs the accounting start date. Every account has no class until the owner gives one, so everything starts as 'unclassified'.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Read only. Give the accounts a class in the Classes tab (or fill the blanks with the usual practice there).
entries.who_can_change: Anyone with the profit report right or accounts rights; the CSV also needs the export right.

entries.title: Working capital
entries.what_it_does: Current assets minus current liabilities by the class the owner gave each account, and the plain formula cash + customer receivables + inventory - supplier payables.
entries.why_it_matters: There was no working capital figure. Loans and VAT are not part of it.
entries.default: If no account is classed current, the class figure says 'Not captured' and never 0; the formula still shows.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone with the profit report right or accounts rights.

entries.title: Account classes
entries.what_it_does: For each chart account an optional cash-flow class (operating, investing, financing) and balance class (current, non-current). Blank means unclassified. A button fills only the blanks with the usual practice, after a preview and with a reason.
entries.why_it_matters: The owner, not the software, decides which class an account belongs to. Nothing is guessed.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Changes the cash-flow statement and working capital only. Every change is in the audit log; a class is cleared by blanking it, never deleted.
entries.who_can_change: The owner or an accounts manager.

entries.title: Materials with no cost (Costing screen)
entries.what_it_does: A list on the Costing screen of ingredients and packaging used by active recipes that have no cost under the chosen cost method, with a CSV.
entries.why_it_matters: A recipe cost with a missing material is incomplete, not zero.
entries.default: Shown automatically to people who may see costs of the place.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone with the cost right of the place; the CSV also needs the export right.

entries.title: Balance sheet check on the owner board
entries.what_it_does: The Balance sheet check tile now reads the books (acct_balance_sheet). It used to call a function that does not exist and was always empty.
entries.why_it_matters: A tile that is always empty looks like a healthy empty state.
entries.default: Shown automatically on the owner board.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Green when assets equal liabilities plus equity; empty when the accounting module is not switched on.
